# Draft:Al-Khwarizmi University

Al-Khwarizmi University
Al-Khwarizmi University is a public university in Khorezm, northwestern Uzbekistan. Established on 30 April 2025 by Presidential Decree No. PQ-160, the university focuses on education and research in technology, engineering, and artificial intelligence. It is named after the renowned scholar Muhammad ibn Musa al-Khwarizmi, whose contributions to mathematics and algorithms laid the foundations for modern science.
History
Al-Khwarizmi University was founded as part of Uzbekistan’s national strategy to modernize and internationalize higher education in science and technology.
The university was established under the guidance of the Specialized Education Agency and the Ministry of Preschool and School Education of Uzbekistan. Its development drew on the educational model of New Uzbekistan University, adapting proven curriculum frameworks, partnerships, and operational systems to the needs of western Uzbekistan.
The institution integrates Central Asia’s rich scientific heritage with modern technological education and aims to cultivate future-ready professionals capable of contributing to Uzbekistan’s digital transformation.
Leadership
Honorary President: Islam ElHadary
Executive Director: Murotjon Islamov
Deputy Executive Director for Financial and Administrative Affairs: Mashhurjon No'monov
Academic Programs
Al-Khwarizmi University offers Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) programs in:
Software Engineering – Focused on software design, development, testing, and system architecture.
Artificial Intelligence – Covers machine learning, data science, intelligent systems, and algorithmic design.
Engineering of Drone Technologies – Integrates aerospace engineering, robotics, embedded systems, and autonomous control for unmanned aerial systems.
Founding Institutions
The university operates under the strategic guidance of the Specialized Education Agency and the Ministry of Preschool and School Education of Uzbekistan, ensuring alignment with national reforms in science, technology, and innovation education.
Mission and Vision
The mission of Al-Khwarizmi University is to serve as a national and regional hub for research, innovation, and advanced education. Its vision is to prepare highly skilled professionals who lead Uzbekistan’s digital transformation while integrating Central Asia’s scientific heritage with contemporary educational and research standards.
Location
Al-Khwarizmi University is located in Khorezm, a historically and culturally significant region in northwestern Uzbekistan. The region is known for its scientific legacy and the city of Khiva, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
